## Summary

There is a medium-severity vulnerability in Traefik's static configuration redaction. The Docker and Swarm provider `password`, the Knative provider `token`, and the HTTP provider `headers` options are not redacted when the static configuration is logged at the `DEBUG` level. The HTTP provider `headers` are also included in the support dump archive and in the anonymous usage statistics. Anyone who can read the Traefik logs, a support dump, or the usage statistics obtains the Docker API password, the Kubernetes bearer token, or the credentials sent to the HTTP configuration endpoint.

Traefik v2 is not affected: the HTTP provider `headers`, the Docker and Swarm `password` and the Knative provider were introduced in v3. The v3.0 to v3.6 lines are end of life and will not receive a patch; the remedy is upgrading to a patched v3.7 or v3.8 release.

## Patches

- https://github.com/traefik/traefik/releases/tag/v3.7.20
- https://github.com/traefik/traefik/releases/tag/v3.8.0

## For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, please [open an issue](https://github.com/traefik/traefik/issues).
